---
 
## [0.1.0] - 2026-05-07
 
### Added
- Full untargeted LC-MS/MS metabolomics pipeline
- Pre-processing : peak detection (`centWave`), retention time alignment (`obiwarp`), feature grouping (`PeakDensity`)
- Processing : RT filtering, QC, outlier filtering, missing value imputation, LOESS drift correction, normalization, transformation, scaling
- Feature annotation via Compound Discoverer export table
- Statistical analysis : PCA, HCPC, heatmap, RF, OPLS-DA, PLS-DA, volcano plot
- Interactive Shiny-based user guidance interface
- Safety R Environment Checkpoints for partial re-execution
- `renv.lock` for reproducible environment management
- MIT License
